summary: Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its monthly NAV per share as of May 31, 2026. The filing reports NAV per share for ten share classes ranging from $19.8520 to $20.0940, with total NAV of $1.365 billion on 68.4 million shares outstanding. No transactions, offers, or strategic actions are announced; this is a routine periodic disclosure by the REIT. There are no deal terms, structures, or actionable catalysts. Investors should view this as standard NAV reporting with no special-situation implications.
